html: ‡ † [סְבַל] vb. si vera l. bear, carry a load (v. BH);—Pōʿ. Pt. pass. אֻשֹּׁ֫הִי מְסוֹבְלִים (K§ 36 NöGGA, 1884, 1016) Ezr 6:3 its foundations (be) raised (Thes al.; WCG 203, 225), very dub.; HptGu ad loc. conj. אֶשֹּׁהִי מְס׳ his (God’s) fire-offerings they bring (Assyrian zabâlu), so (hesitantly) Berthol.
